name: Lookora
summary: AI virtual try-on of stylist-made outfits on your own photo, in the browser or on iPhone, with no avatar and no subscription. Three free looks a month in the iPhone app.
description: AI virtual try-on of stylist-made outfits on your own photo, in the browser or on iPhone, with no avatar and no subscription. Three free looks a month in the iPhone app.

pricing.details: iPhone app: 3 looks a month free, no card. The browser has no free tier. Look packs, paid once: 1 € for 5 looks, or 4 € for 30 looks. No subscription; looks never expire.
